items.stem:
【原文 · Australia】
Australia was a country I always wanted to visit. This year I saved up some money and booked a flight to go travelling. I had some friends studying there, so it was a perfect opportunity to see friends and travel around.

The flight made me realize exactly how far away Australia is from home. I spent 10 hours flying from London to Hong Kong, then a further 8 hours to Sydney, my first stop in Australia. The flight went quite quickly though, since there were lots of films to keep me entertained.

When I arrived, I felt strange. Everything was upside down over there. It was the start of winter in May! Fortunately, for me the weather was still warm and sunny. It also took me a while to get used to the time difference.

Australia is truly beautiful. It is full of views and wildlife you would not find anywhere else in the world. One of the highlights of my trip was visiting a koala (考拉) reserve in Brisbane. There were koalas everywhere sleeping in the trees. I even got a chance to hold one. I learnt lots of facts about koalas too. They can sleep for up to 22 hours a day to save energy! At the reserve there was also a big lawn full of kangaroos (袋鼠). We were allowed to feed and touch them. They were really cute and friendly.

I loved visiting Australia, from the mountains and waterfalls in the National Parks to the long white sandy beaches. It's an incredible country and worth visiting. I'm already dreaming of going back!

I longed for a visit to Australia.
items.analysis: 开头就说澳大利亚是他一直想去的国家。

【原文 · Veganism】
Veganism. What does it mean? To some of you it might be a completely new word. And it's certainly a word I have only become familiar with in recent years. A vegan diet is one that contains no animal products. That means no meat, no milk no eggs, etc.

11. According to Paragraph 1, a vegan diet is ________.
items.analysis: 第 1 段说 vegan diet 不含任何动物制品。

items.stem:
【原文 · Veganism】
I became interested in vegan lifestyle months ago. As I was surfing videos on the Internet, I came across a woman called Freelee. She claimed to regularly eat around fifty bananas a day to stay healthy. Fifty bananas! I quickly realized that this was not the diet for me. However, what she was saying about veganism did pique my interest. And I went on to watch many more vegan videos. Eventually, I switched to veganism about six months ago.

12. The author knew the vegan lifestyle through ________.
items.analysis: 原文说他在网上刷视频时接触到 vegan 生活方式。

items.stem:
【原文 · Veganism】
While veganism is often associated with physical weakness, that is certainly not the case for me. I have discovered many delicious vegan products, which one might never consider as vegan.

Personally, eating this way has given me a much more positive outlook on life. Another vegan Kristina's story is even more amazing. Kristina was bitten by a deadly spider. She was not given the medicines required to survive the bite. Yet she made a full and speedy recovery. She attributes it to the magic power of a vegan lifestyle.

14. The author believes that the vegan diet is ________.
items.analysis: 原文说素食没有让他虚弱,反而让他更积极,认为有益健康。

items.chapterName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.stem:
【原文 · Bottled Water 第①段】
Over the last 15 years, more and more people in the US have been drinking bottled water. There is no sign of slowing down. In fact, sales of bottled water are going up faster than other kind of drink. It is true even in cities where it is safe to drink tap water. This has been a disaster for the environment and for our health.

请为第 ① 段选择正确的小标题:

options.text: Need for a better image of tap water

items.analysis: 第①段讲瓶装水销量持续上升。

items.sectionName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.chapterName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.stem:
【原文 · Bottled Water 第②段】
Most bottled water comes from underground water. Much of this underground water have flowed into rivers and lakes. Using this water can make droughts (干旱) more serious. Many companies use water from mountain glaciers (冰川), but this is not much better. When the glacier melts, the water usually flows to areas like rivers or wetlands. When companies take glacier water, they take it from areas that need it.

请为第 ② 段选择正确的小标题:

options.text: Need for a better image of tap water

items.analysis: 第②段讲取水加剧干旱。

items.sectionName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.chapterName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.stem:
【原文 · Bottled Water 第③段】
It takes about 1.6 liters of water to make one liter of bottled water. This wastes a lot of water. Also transporting the bottled water to stores burns fuel and creates pollution. The problems do not stop when the water reaches people who buy it. Water bottles are made from plastic which does not break down. Although it can be recycled, people usually do not put it in the recycle can.

请为第 ③ 段选择正确的小标题:

options.text: Need for a better image of tap water

items.analysis: 第③段讲生产运输浪费水并造成污染。

items.sectionName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.chapterName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.stem:
【原文 · Bottled Water 第④段】
Some may say that bottled water is safer and healthier than tap water. But that is not true. Sometimes chemicals or bacteria get into bottled water, and companies have to destroy them. Actually, tap water is often healthier than bottled water. Bottled water may lack fluoride (氟化物) which helps protect our teeth. Fluoride is found in tiny amounts in tap water.

请为第 ④ 段选择正确的小标题:

options.text: Need for a better image of tap water

items.analysis: 第④段讲瓶装水也可能含有害物质。

items.sectionName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.chapterName: 第三部分 概括段落大意和补全句子
items.stem:
【原文 · Bottled Water 第⑤段】
Obviously, more people need to know that tap water is safer and healthier. Unfortunately, tap water cannot advertise itself. When a product that is cheaper and better does not win, that is bad news. When the product is water, we all lose.

请为第 ⑤ 段选择正确的小标题:

options.text: Need for a better image of tap water

items.analysis: 第⑤段讲自来水需要更好的形象宣传。

items.sectionName: 第七部分 短文写作
items.chapterName: 第七部分 短文写作
items.stem:
某英文报社正在举办题为 "Safe Journey" 的征文活动。请你根据下述写作要点提交一篇英文短文应征。
· 旅途中安全的重要性。
· 旅途中应该特别注意的事项。

(要求 100 词左右,答案写在答题纸上。)
answerPoints: 点明旅途安全的重要性(如避免意外、保障顺利出行)
列出旅途中应特别注意的事项(如保管财物、注意交通与住宿安全、留意天气与当地规定)
结构完整:开头引入、正文分点、结尾总结,词数 100 左右
items.analysis: 应用文写作按要点给分:第一段点题说明安全的重要性,第二段分点写注意事项,结尾一句收束。
